address: 22 Old Bakery Street, Valletta, VLT 1454, Malta
bio: Located in the heart of Valletta’s historic centre, this restaurant, unlike many of its counterparts, doesn’t offer outdoor seating, but features two warm, inviting dining rooms with old stone walls and a kitchen visible from the street. The focus is on Maltese surf and turf dishes that showcase fresh, seasonal, locally sourced ingredients. Guests can choose between two tasting menus, Land or Sea, or order from the à la carte lineup. The wine list includes Maltese, Italian and French labels, with some available by the glass. Be sure to book in advance....
